name: jellyfin/catalog-search
title: Jellyfin Catalog Search
description: Search movies, shows, episodes and music across the selected user's currently visible libraries, including custom-named libraries. Optional type, year and genre filters can be refined, and truncated results can be continued with next_start.

username.description: Optional Jellyfin user; omit when the acting user resolves unambiguously

query.description: Title or other Jellyfin search text

library_id.description: Optional exact ID from list_libraries; omit to search all visible libraries

include_item_types.description: Optional Jellyfin item types; defaults to movies, series, seasons, episodes, audio, music albums/artists and music videos

start.description: Offset per visible library; pass the previous result's next_start to continue
